en.t: The carriage stopped inside the middle gate.

units.source_text: 这中门已经歪斜得厉害，几乎倒塌了。

en.t: The middle gate was already badly askew and almost collapsing.

units.source_text: 源氏公子睹此景象，心中想道：“夜里看时，已经觉得寒酸，然而隐蔽之处尚多；

en.t: Seeing this sight, Prince Genji thought to himself, "When I saw it at night, it already seemed shabby, but there were still many places hidden from view;

units.source_text: 今天早上阳光之下一看，更显得荒凉寂寞，教人好不伤心！

en.t: now, seeing it this morning in the sunlight, it looks even more desolate and lonely, and how painfully sad it is!

units.source_text: 只有青松上的白雪，沉沉欲下，倒有温暖之趣，教人联想山乡风味，引人凄清岑寂之感。

en.t: Only the white snow on the green pines, hanging heavily as if about to fall, has a somewhat warm charm, calling to mind the flavor of a mountain village and stirring a feeling of chill, clear solitude.

units.source_text: 那天雨夜品评时左马头所说的‘蔓草荒烟的蓬门茅舍’，便是指这种地方吧。

en.t: The 'humble cottage with a brushwood gate amid creeping weeds and desolate smoke' that the Captain of the Left Gate Guards spoke of during that rainy-night discussion must have meant a place like this.

units.source_text: 如果有个可怜可爱的人儿住在这里，教人多么恋恋不舍！

en.t: If some pitiable and lovely person lived here, how hard it would be to leave!

units.source_text: 我那种悖伦之恋[\[11\]](#part1335.html#m11)的忧思，也可借此得到慰藉吧。

en.t: Perhaps the sorrow of that forbidden love of mine[\[11\]](#part1335.html#m11) could also find comfort through this.

units.source_text: 现在这个人的样子，和这理想的环境全然不符，真教人毫无办法。

en.t: But this person's present appearance does not suit this ideal setting at all, and it truly leaves one at a loss.

units.source_text: 倘不是我，换了别人，决不会耐性忍气地照拂这位小姐。

en.t: If it were not I, anyone else would never patiently endure things and look after this young lady.

units.source_text: 我之所以如此顾念她，大概是她的父亲常陆亲王记挂女儿，那阴魂来指使我的吧。”

en.t: The reason I am so mindful of her is probably that her father, Prince Hitachi, still worries about his daughter, and his lingering spirit is directing me."
